description: List incidents linked to a problem ticket in Zendesk. Use when you need to retrieve all incident tickets that share the same root cause as a problem ticket. Incidents are tickets of type 'incident' that are related to a problem ticket via the problem_id field. Supports both offset and cursor-based pagination.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing ticket incidents in Zendesk.

page.description: Page number for offset pagination (starts at 1). Cannot be used with cursor pagination.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results you want to view. Start at 1 and increase to browse through more incidents.
page.title: Page

page_after.description: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's next link or cursor.
page_after.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the next set of results in cursor-based pagination.
page_after.title: Page After

page_before.description: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's prev link or cursor.
page_before.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the previous set of results in cursor-based pagination.
page_before.title: Page Before

page_size.description: Number of incidents per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use with page_after or page_before for large datasets.
page_size.human_parameter_description: Number of incidents per page using cursor-based pagination. Recommended for large datasets.
page_size.title: Page Size

per_page.description: Number of incidents to return per page (max 100). Cannot be used with cursor pagination.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many incidents to show on each page. You can choose up to 100; smaller numbers can make pages load faster.
per_page.title: Per Page

ticket_id.description: The ID of the problem ticket to list incidents for. Incidents are tickets of type 'incident' that are linked to this problem ticket.
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the problem ticket whose related incidents you want to retrieve. You can find this ID in the ticket URL or from a ticket list.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
